title: 茶摘み (Chatsumi — Tea Picking)
description: A lively 1912 song about the tea-picking season on the 88th day after the start of spring (early May), when frost danger has passed and the young leaves are at their best. Workers in red sashes and sedge hats pick tea with care — 'pick it, pick it, keep picking; if you don't pick, it won't become Japan's tea.' Based on traditional folk songs from the Uji Tawara tea-growing village in Kyoto.
license: Public Domain (Traditional tea-picking folk song adapted for 尋常小学唱歌; published 1912 — copyright expired)
